risk_if_not_implemented: Without Personnel Termination, trusted insiders may misuse access or act on conflicts of interest without detection or deterrence. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Excessive or Unauthorized Privilege (R-AC-2), Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a formal user registration and de-registration process that governs the assignment of access rights.
compensating_control_1.justification: User Provisioning & De-Provisioning (IAC-04) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Personnel Termination (HRS-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Account Management
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to:
(1) Define authorized system account types;
(2) Define prohibited system account types; and
(3) Proactively govern individual, group, system, service, application, guest and temporary accounts.
compensating_control_2.justification: Account Management (IAC-08) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Personnel Termination (HRS-12) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
